description:
Overview

ComPDF Conversion SDK is a high-performance library designed for extracting and transforming the data within your PDF files, such as text, images, tables, links, and annotations, into various file formats. Our Conversion SDK retains the original document layout and the properties of the file data, ensuring a seamless document conversion experience.

Effortlessly integrate the ComPDF Conversion SDK into your projects in just a few steps, and enable the following file format conversions:

- Convert PDF to Word (.docx)
- Convert PDF to Excel (.xlsx)
- Convert PDF to PowerPoint (.pptx)
- Convert PDF to HTML (.html)
- Convert PDF to CSV (.csv)
- Convert PDF to Image (.png, .jpg, .jpeg,.jpeg2000, .bmp, .tiff, .tga, .gif, .webp)
- Convert PDF to Plain Text (.txt)
- Convert PDF to Rich Text Format (.rtf)
- Convert PDF to Searchable PDF (.pdf)
- Convert PDF to OFD (.ofd)
- Convert PDF to Structured Data (.json)
- Convert PDF to Markdown (.md)

Harness the power of ComPDF Conversion SDK and take your document processing to the next level with intelligent tools designed for accuracy and efficiency. To enhance your format conversion results, ComPDF offers AI-powered document tools with the following capabilities:

- Optical Character Recognition (OCR)
- Layout Analysis
- Table Recognition


Why ComPDF Conversion SDK

- Mature Technology

  With years of technology accumulation, we have established a complete mechanism of product iteration to offer a continuous guarantee for product competitiveness.

- Complete PDF and Format Conversion Functionalities

  Our comprehensive features can meet diverse needs and are easy for our customers to use without training costs.

- High-quality Service

  professional service and technical support to quickly respond to users' feedback through onsite service or remote support like telephone, email, etc.

- Independent Intellectual   

  Property Rights
  Our technology is independent and compliant with ISO, helping enterprises conduct international business without considering copyright risks.


ComPDF Conversion SDK

The ComPDF Conversion SDK is designed to facilitate the effortless conversion of PDF files into various other formats, all while preserving the original layout and formatting of the documents. In this guide, we will explore the ComPDF Conversion SDK and demonstrate how to utilize it within your C++ projects. 

License and Trial

The ComPDF Conversion SDK is a commercial SDK that requires a license to grant developers the right to develop and distribute their applications. In development mode, each license is only valid for one device ID. ComPDF provides flexible licensing models, please contact [our marketing team](mailto:support@compdf.com) for more information. However, even if you have a license, it is prohibited to distribute any documents, sample code, or source code of the ComPDF Conversion SDK to any third parties.

If you do not have a License, please feel free to contact the [ComPDF Team](https://www.compdf.com/contact-sales) to obtain a License to try the ComPDF Conversion SDK.

FAQ

- Does OCR work on x86 architecture?

  Currently, the OCR only works on x64 architecture.

Contact Us

Thanks for your interest in ComPDF Conversion SDK, the easy-to-use and powerful development solution. If you encounter technical questions or bug issues when using ComPDF Conversion SDK, please submit the problem report to the [ComPDF team](mailto:support@compdf.com). More information as follows would help us to solve your problem:

- ComPDF Conversion SDK product and version.

- Any other related information, such as an error screenshot.

releaseNotes:
ComPDFKit Conversion SDK v4.2.0 Release Date: 26 August 2026
=====================================================

Enhanced Features

Core:
- Added support for GIF images as conversion input.
- Improved conversion speed for large and complex documents.
- Reduced peak memory usage when converting image-heavy documents.

PDF to Word:
- Added support for converting PDF vector graphics into editable Word shapes, with fill and line styles preserved.
- Improved editability: the output relies less on paragraph spacing for page layout and uses more natural line spacing, so the layout stays stable after editing.
- Improved recognition of graphically drawn list bullets.
- Added support for restoring fraction equations as Word equations.

PDF to Searchable PDF:
- Improved accuracy and performance of the searchable text layer.
- Reduced output file size.
- Reduced meaningless spaces in the searchable text layer, so complete English words can be searched.

OCR and AI:
- Added document orientation detection and skew correction.
- Improved OCR paragraph font sizing and word-break accuracy.

Table Recognition:
- Improved structure recognition for ruled, sparsely ruled and borderless tables.

Issues Addressed

Core:
- Improved conversion stability and fixed crashes on documents with invalid text objects or circular bookmarks.
- Improved consistency of font selection and color extraction across repeated conversions.
- Improved handling of spaces, character mapping, overlapping text, page orientation and form fields.

PDF to Word:
- Restored natural line spacing for regular paragraphs, using fixed line spacing only where required.
- Improved multi-column layout, including column detection, column spacing and columns spanning sections.
- Improved paragraph alignment, first line indent, hanging indent and right indent accuracy.
- Improved list recognition and reduced false positives from hyphenated words, paired punctuation and tab-separated columns.
- Improved list numbering, indentation, tab stops and nested list levels.
- Improved table recognition, including missing headers, empty columns being split incorrectly, multi-level headers and incorrect cell merging.
- Fixed loss of images, line segments, borders and vertically merged cell content in tables.
- Improved table row height, column width, cell padding, cell background, cell content placement and last row pagination.
- Fixed duplicated text boxes, clipped text in floating text boxes, squeezed rotated labels and list numbering restarting across text boxes.
- Fixed black text being exported as red, and preserved text transparency.
- Improved recognition of superscripts, subscripts, strikethrough, hyphenation, quotation marks and drop caps.
- Improved character and word spacing accuracy, including justified text.
- Improved image and graphic handling, including transparency, text wrapping and object order.
- Improved header, footer, page background and page rotation handling.

Fonts:
- Fixed one source font being replaced by several different fonts in the same document.
- Improved simplified and traditional Chinese detection, Korean font matching, symbol font handling and font name decoding.
- Improved cross-platform font measurement consistency.
- Improved font scaling and character spacing, including narrow characters that were compressed until invisible.
- Fixed missing characters for non-embedded fonts on Linux.

PDF to Excel:
- Fixed multi-line paragraphs being truncated and excessive blank space in cells.
- Fixed cell alignment, indentation consistency and text region misjudgment.
- Fixed Wingdings list icons, highlight backgrounds affecting adjacent cells and annotation image export.
- Fixed conversion failures caused by control characters.

PDF to Searchable PDF:
- Fixed text selection width and character positioning.
- Fixed background residue and plain text layout.

PDF to HTML:
- Fixed the outline table of contents not being generated.

Please refer to the developer_guide_windows.pdf document in the same folder as this file for additional information.
